title: Fractured Muse
description: A woman in an emerald green gown stands amid a crumbling wall, holding a white theatrical mask in her right hand while her own face appears split by the cracks. The decaying room features tilted classical portraits on the walls, scattered film reels and photographs on the floor, and a rainy window revealing a neon sign outside.
prompt: A beautiful woman in an elegant emerald green off-shoulder gown stands in a decaying room with cracked and crumbling walls revealing golden light. She holds a white comedy mask in her hand, her own face partially split by the fractures. Classical oil portraits hang crooked on the walls, film reels and scattered photographs lie on the wooden floor, rain streaks down the window showing a neon sign. Dramatic cinematic lighting, painterly style, moody atmosphere.
